scope: projectable HMT U(1) gravity A-field constraint and reduced-measure preflight

source_lock.primary: Mukohyama, Namba, Saitou, Watanabe, arXiv:1504.07357, projectable appendix / Hamiltonian constraint analysis
required_claims: projectable U(1) phase space contains A and pi_A
projectable theory has explicit first- and second-class constraints
A appears as a constrained/non-propagating sector in the total Hamiltonian
gauge-fixing terms are specified at the classical Hamiltonian level

formal_check.assumption: for a linear multiplier term integral A*C, integrating over A formally imposes delta[C] up to normalization
formal_check.must_not_infer: that delta[C] alone is the complete reduced quantum measure

pass_requirements: source-lock the A constraint role in the projectable HMT Hamiltonian structure
verify the formal multiplier-to-delta-functional identity only within its stated scope
separately audit whether a unique full second-class/reduced functional determinant is source-locked
frozen_nonclaims: do not import ordinary projectable Hořava beta functions
do not claim HMT renormalizability or nonrenormalizability
do not claim full one-loop evaluability unless the second-class/reduced measure is uniquely specified
do not unblock k=0.03 Mpc^-1 production
expected_semantics: A scoped PASS may establish a formal constraint reduction while leaving the physical one-loop determinant OPEN. Missing determinant data is a scientific/evaluability blocker, not a failed frozen criterion.
